title: Assertion Ledger Card — compact assertion + retry ledger for request detail
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact 'Assertion Ledger' card that sits in the right rail of the Request Detail view. The card summarizes assertion failures, retry history, and error taxonomy for a single request (or request group) so engineers can quickly triage without leaving the flow. Key goals: surface the most actionable signal (failed assertions and their most recent stack/context), show a condensed retry ledger (timestamps, status, latency delta), expose quick actions (replay request, open payload snapshot, file bug, link to model/version), and indicate cost impact of retries. Must be finger-friendly for touch, collapse gracefully, and have accessible color/contrast for severity states.
acceptance_criteria: Card appears in Request Detail rail when request has >=1 assertion failure or >=1 retry
Top row shows assertion tag(s) with taxonomy (syntax, hallucination, rate-limit, infra, unknown) and primary assertion message truncated to 120 chars
Retry ledger lists up to 6 recent retries with timestamp, result (success/error), delta latency, and small badge for applied mitigation (backoff, fallback model)
Quick actions: Replay (opens retry composer), Snapshot (opens immutable payload snapshot), Create Bug (opens pre-filled ticket modal), Link to Deploy/Model Version
Mobile/compact breakpoint collapses ledger into summary: "1 assertion • 3 retries • +220ms cost" with expand affordance
Figma prototype flows for desktop and mobile provided and reviewed by Eng and PM
Usability test (n=6 engineers) shows median time-to-action reduced vs baseline card by >=30%
Design tokens and color states documented; accessibility contrast passes WCAG AA for all severity states
comments: 2025-07-12 — Ava Patel: Initial sketch uploaded to Figma and spec doc created in Confluence. Core idea: reduce triage scatter — assertions + retries in one compact card. Asked Eng to confirm feasible telemetry surface (assertion message length, retry metadata).

Suggested condensing mitigation badges to 2-letter codes to save space. Added ENG-4891 as dependency for telemetry contract.

2025-07-14 — Jordan Blake (PM): Requested adding cost delta estimate per retry and tying to the existing cost breakdown API. Marked this as high visibility for a customer that surfaced repeated retries affecting billing. Added label 'cost-affecting'.

2025-07-15 — Sofia Rios (Design): Iteration 2 uploaded — introduced collapsed mobile state and keyboard interactions. Noted accessibility checks in spec. Ready for cross-functional review on 2025-07-16 meeting.

2025-07-16 — Design Review: Feedback: shorten primary assertion copy to 2-line clamp, add hover preview for full payload snippet, ensure 'Replay' opens composer with prefilled assertion filter. Action: update prototype and add microcopy for actions.

2025-07-17 — Marcus Li: Implemented mock backend endpoints for the prototype (PR 118). Requested final layout widths and token budget for the console to avoid overflow in narrow panes. Confirmed performance impact negligible for streaming requests.

2025-07-18 — Usability: Early lab (n=6) shows participants reached 'open snapshot' action 35% faster. Two participants missed the mitigation badge meaning — updated tooltip copy and added short legend. Marking ticket 'In Review' pending final UXPolish and design handoff.
